primary.bootstrap: 10,000 draws over engines/drives, stratified by fleet/target
primary.multiplicity: Holm across H1-H8, one-sided bootstrap p-values
primary.supported_if: 95% CI criterion met AND Holm p < 0.05

hypotheses.H1: C-MAPSS, same fleet, official test units: point alerts (predicted RUL <= W) miss more than alpha of at-risk engines (CI lower > 0.10).
hypotheses.H2: C-MAPSS, same fleet: the guard misses at most alpha + margin (CI upper <= 0.15).
hypotheses.H3a: C-MAPSS, same fleet: guard false-alarm rate is lower than the split-conformal lower bound's (CI upper of difference < 0).
hypotheses.H3b: C-MAPSS, same fleet: guard false-alarm rate is lower than conformalized quantile regression's (CI upper of difference < 0).
hypotheses.H4: C-MAPSS, 12 cross-fleet transfers: the source-calibrated guard misses more than alpha (CI lower > 0.10).
hypotheses.H5: C-MAPSS, cross-fleet: the guard re-calibrated on 20 target-fleet failures misses at most alpha + margin (CI upper <= 0.15).
hypotheses.H6: Backblaze, P3 (3 months after calibration): the SMART-rule (any of SMART 5/187/188/197/198 raw > 0) misses more than alpha (CI lower > 0.10).
hypotheses.H7: Backblaze, P3: the guard (fit P1, calibrated P2) misses at most alpha + margin (CI upper <= 0.15).
hypotheses.H8: Backblaze, manufacturer held out of fitting and calibration: the guard re-calibrated on 20 of its P2 failures misses at most alpha + margin on its P3 drives (CI upper <= 0.15).

exploratory: false-alarm cost of every method; Backblaze catch rate at 1% / 5% inspection budgets and whether the calibration certificate (m+1)/(n+1) holds in P3
Beta(n+1-k, k) prediction of the spread of realised miss rates after recalibration
disclosures: Before freezing, the official FD001 test set was used to replicate the public benchmark (run_fd001.py), and FD001/FD003 test sets were used once in pilot_conformal.py (Random Forest, different features). All method and parameter choices were then made on training-file splits (dev mode) only.
Backblaze development used P1 (Jan-Jun 2024) only; P2/P3 outcomes were not examined before freezing.
